description: Lignes haute tension aériennes (EDF) en Guadeloupe is a dataset listed in KaruData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF-SEI. Ce jeu de données présente l'ensemble des lignes haute tension (HTA) aériennes de Guadeloupe. Ces données sont publiées à titre purement indicatif, EDF ne peut garantir leur exactitude et leur exhaustivité. Des mises à jour seront publiées régulièrement. Coverage: Guadeloupe. The portal files it under Aménagement durable du territoire. Its keywords are Lignes, HTA, Réseau, Aérien. The portal shows 1,819 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-karudata-com-portal.
